title: KYA Compliance Firewall
description: Four-stage Know-Your-Agent (KYA) agentic compliance firewall: prompt-injection scan (T282), FATF customer risk rating (T477), Visa TAP signature verification (T286), AML mandate compilation (T131). Each stage output gates the next. Outputs a composite KYA clearance record and chain-of-custody audit log.

mcp_tool_definition.name: kya_compliance_firewall
mcp_tool_definition.description: Run the four-stage KYA compliance firewall: injection scan → FATF risk → TAP identity → AML mandate. Returns a clearance decision (CLEARED/BLOCKED/ESCALATE) and chain-of-custody audit log.

transaction_context.description: The transaction context or agent instruction text to scan

customer_risk_tier.description: Pre-computed FATF risk tier (from T477) or omit to run T477 inline

tap_cleared.description: TAP identity verified (from T286) or omit to run T286 inline
